load.enter_text: Enter base64 code, or puzzle ID.
export.empty_detected: Empty cell detected. Do you want to copy anyway?
rule.[Sudoku]: Sudoku: Fill all the cells with digit 1-9.
rule.[R]: Row: Each row cannot have duplicate digits.
rule.[C]: Column: Each column cannot have duplicate digits.
rule.[B]: Box: Each bold-bordered 3x3 box cannot have duplicate digits.
rule.[DT]: Distant: Orthogonally or diagonally adjacent cells cannot have the same digit.
rule.[SG]: Segment: Each bold-bordered segments cannot have duplicate digits.
rule.[LK]: Link: Digits in two cells connected by a diamond must differ by 1.
rule.[LO]: Lotus: Circled cell must be either greater than or less than all orthogonally adjacent cells.
rule.[MR]: Metro: Digits on a colored line must form a set of non-repeating consecutive digits, in any order.
rule.[SQ]: Sequence: Red digits outside the grid indicate the order in which the digits appear in the corresponding row/column. (digits outside the grid does not affect any other rules)
rule.[QT]: Quantum: If a green clue 'X Y' is given outside the grid, exactly one of the following is true in the corresponding row/column: 'the Xth digit is Y' and 'the Yth digit is X.' (digits outside the grid does not affect any other rules)
rule.[RG]: Range: Blue numbers outside the grid indicate the distance between 1 and 9 in the corresponding row/column. (digits outside the grid does not affect any other rules)
rule.[QD]: Quad: Every 2×2 region must contain at least one odd and one even digit.
rule.[RF]: Reference: If a row/column marked with a thick red line is the Xth row/column, then whenever a cell in that row/column contains Y, the Yth cell of the intersecting column/row must contain X.
rule.[PR]: Prism: The two digits separated by a red hexagon form a two-digit prime number, while the two digits separated by a blue hexagon form a two-digit square number. In rows, the left digit is the tens digit; in columns, the top digit is the tens digit.
rule.[TM]: Temperature: The sum of the three digits in a blue region is at most 10, in a green region exactly 15, and in a red region at least 20.
rule.[RT]: Root: In a cell with a gray number, the distance to the nearest matching digit is equal to the shown value.
rule.[PO]: Point: For two cells connected by a triangle, the triangle points to the greater digit.
rule.[ST]: Stencil: When a stencil piece is placed on the grid with rotation and reflection allowed, there must be no position where all digits on the piece exactly match the digits on the grid.
rule.[VT]: Vector: If a cell containing a triangle has digit X, then the cell located X cells away in the direction the triangle points contains 9.
rule.[SR]: Stream: Digits on a light blue line must alternate between odd and even.
rule.[PA]: Pair: No two 2-cell regions outlined with dashed borders may contain the same pair of digits.
rule.[IV]: Inversion: Reading the digits along a green line starting from the large circle, there is exactly one instance where a digit is greater than the following digit.
rule.[TR]: Trail: There exists a path starting at the blue circle and ending at the orange circle that moves orthogonally and follows the sequence … → 1 → 2 → … → 8 → 9 → 1 → ….
rule.[ES]: Escape: Every orthogonally connected region of even digits must touch the top or bottom edge of the grid.
rule.[TP]: Triplet: Digits in any three consecutive diagonally connected cells cannot be arranged in increasing or decreasing order.
rule.[EP]: Epsilon: All cells containing 1, 2, 3, or 4 form orthogonally connected regions of exactly 3 cells each.
rule.[PD]: Product: Brown numbers outside the grid equals the product of the first three digits from that edge in the corresponding row/column. (digits outside the grid does not affect any other rules)
rule.[BP]: Bumper: A 'bumper' is a cell whose digit differs by at least 3 from every orthogonally adjacent cell. Each row and column contains exactly one bumper.
rule.[BD]: Bridge: There are X non-intersecting chains starting from the marked cells on the left edge of the grid. A 'chain' is a group of 9 digits arranged in cyclic order 1-2-3-4-5-6-7-8-9, connected horizontally or diagonally across the grid from the left edge to the right edge.
rule.[EF]: Reflex: In the 3×3 area centered on a yellow-circled cell, if there are X marked cells with digits less than or equal to that cell, then the digit in the cell is X.
rule.[AQ]: Aquarium: Within a cyan region, every digit in a lower row must be greater than every digit in a higher row.
rule.[MT]: Meta: If a cell marked with a diamond contains X, then there are exactly X occurrences of X among all diamond-marked cells.
rule.[LK']: Link': Digits in two cells connected by a diamond must differ by 1. All possible diamonds are given.
rule.[PR']: Prism': The three digits separated by two red hexagons form a three-digit prime number, while the three digits separated by two blue hexagons form a three-digit square number. In rows, digits are read from left to right; in columns, from top to bottom.
rule.[LO']: Lotus': The digit in a circled cell is equal to the arithmetic mean of the digits in its orthogonally adjacent cells, rounded down.
rule.[QD']: Quad': In every 2×2 region, the sum of the four digits is not a multiple of 3.
rule.[RT']: Root': In a cell with a gray number, the distance to the farthest matching digit is equal to the shown value.
rule.[SQ']: Sequence': Red letters outside the grid indicate the order in which digits appear in the corresponding row or column. L represents 1-3, M represents 4-6, and H represents 7-9. (letters outside the grid does not affect any other rules)
rule.[TR']: Trail': There exist two paths starting at the blue circle and ending at the orange circle that move orthogonally and follow the sequence … → 1 → 2 → … → 8 → 9 → 1 → …, and do not overlap except at the start and end cells.
rule.[RG']: Range': Blue letters outside the grid indicate the distance between '1' and '9' in the corresponding row or column. 'A'-'H' correspond one-to-one with the numbers 1-8, in any order. (letters outside the grid does not affect any other rules)
rule.[SG']: Segment': Each colored segments cannot have duplicate digits.
